answer: The raven counter is kept in karst and terrace makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4463 identities would post 2891 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
